newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar recovers ground after choppy NY.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar recovers ground after choppy NY.

text.p: London's August white sugar contract managed to steer clear of trendline support on Thursday and broadly reflected the turbulent gyrations of the New York raws market, traders said.

London sentiment was quick to follow that in New York once October raws broke through the psychological 11.00 cents/lb barrier but the whites market saw an upturn when fresh fund buying emerged close to 11.02 on the raws.
October raws slid to a low of 10.90 but then rapidly recovered rapidly towards 11.20.
"It (London) has not been too active...it's pretty much been following New York but there's been nothing too spectacular," said one trader.
Volume was boosted by against actuals trades in August as the contract approached expiry on July 16.
At 1600 GMT August was up 40 cents at $319.40, after hitting an intraday low of $316.30 during the slide in New York. October was up 80 cents at $316.00.
Traders said August/October was trading slightly wider than in the morning at between $3.00 and $3.50. Limited arbitrage trading was reported although there was some interest in March/March.
Volume amounted to a solid 2,572 lots, more than half of which was in August.
In Paris volume on the 45 ICUMSA market totalled 365 lots, with August down $1.40 at $317.00 and October up $1.50 at $316.00. Volume on the lesser-quality 100 ICUMSA market reached 85 lots.
